label: Rule of Law (WGI estimate)
source: World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators (Kaufmann and Kraay)
notes: Perceptions of the extent to which agents have confidence in and abide by the rules of society, in particular the quality of contract enforcement, property rights, the police and the courts, and the likelihood of crime and violence. Estimate of the governance score in units of a standard normal distribution, from about -2.5 (weak) to +2.5 (strong), built from many survey and expert sources (Kaufmann and Kraay). Scores are relative to other countries in the same year, so a flat line can hide a change in absolute terms, and a score has a margin of error. Survey years: 1996, 1998, 2000, then every year from 2002. Country rows only (no aggregates); 9 territories without an ISO3 code in the World Bank country list are left out (Anguilla, Cook Islands, French Guiana, Jersey, Martinique, Netherlands Antilles, Niue, Reunion, Taiwan, China). World Bank API source 3, last updated 2026-09-25.
